scope: Broaden English chapter-summary teaching to a fifth book while R9 trains. This preparation neither changes the live run nor inserts another training block before its combined native trial.

source.title: The Book of Tea
source.author: Kakuzo Okakura
source.copyright_catalog: Public domain in the USA; full original license retained with raw text

chapters.heading: I. The Cup of Humanity
chapters.teaching: Main cultural argument rather than details alone; reciprocal understanding versus quoted stereotypes; myth as analogy rather than literal history.

chapters.heading: II. The Schools of Tea.
chapters.teaching: Ordered period/preparation mappings; the stage at which salt is removed; ceremonial retention despite replacement in ordinary consumption; attributed historical interpretations.
